errors.evidence: The description incorrectly transcribes the method names from the x-axis. The correct labels are "CInGS (w/)" and "CInGS", not "ClinGS".

errors.text_span: The bars are arranged in ascending order of their height from left to right
errors.evidence: The bars are not arranged in ascending order. The third bar, "FactTune" (approx. 51), is shorter than the first two bars, "Standard" (approx. 52) and "Self-RAG" (approx. 53.5). The description also contradicts itself, as the values it provides (54, 55, 52, 55, 60) are not in ascending order.
The bar for the "Standard" method has a value of approximately 52, not 54. The bar is clearly less than halfway between 50 and 60.
The bar for the "Self-RAG" method has a value of approximately 53.5, which is below the 55 mark.
The bar for the "FactTune" method has a value of approximately 51, not 52. It is the shortest bar in the chart.
The bar for the "CInGS (w/)" method has a value of approximately 53, which is below the 55 mark.
The bar for the "CInGS" method, while the highest, has a value clearly below the 60 gridline, at approximately 59.
